title: Bitcoin Lockdown: 14 Million BTC Now In Cold Storage As Holders Dig In
body: According to on-chain analytics firm Glassnode, more than 14 million Bitcoin have sat idle in wallets with little to no spending history. That leaves only about 7 million BTC out of the total 21 million supply ready for trading. This shift points to a growing number of holders who prefer long-term storage over quick trades. Related Reading: Double Win: Dogwifhat Jumps 24% Alongside Bitcoin’s $107K Push Steep Rise In Illiquid Bitcoin Based on reports, the illiquid supply of Bitcoin climbed from just under 14 million in December 2024—when Bitcoin first broke the $100K mark—to roughly 14.30 million today. Demand for cold storage and self-custody solutions has never been higher. Investors are moving coins off exchanges and into private wallets. That trend has been especially sharp since late March, even though price swings have stayed volatile. Bitcoin’s illiquid supply just crossed 14 million $BTC More and more holders are pulling coins off exchanges choosing cold storage over quick trades. The message is clear: conviction is growing, and they’re here for the long haul. #Bitcoin #BTC #CryptoHODL pic.twitter.com/bQozg31mBK — Erica Hazel (@Erica__Hazel) June 26, 2025 Corporate Buyers Ramp Up Holdings In just the past week, more than five companies announced new Bitcoin purchases. ProCap BTC led the way with two buys: 3,724 BTC for $387 million and 1,208 BTC for $128 million, adding up to 4,930 BTC worth $515 million. Michael Saylor’s Strategy added 245 BTC after spending $1 billion the week before. Smarter Web picked up 197 BTC, while Méliuz S.A. acquired 275 BTC, taking its total to 596 BTC. The Blockchain Group chipped in with 75 BTC, bringing its haul to 1,728 BTC. Most recently, Metaplanet spent around $132 million on 1,234 BTC, lifting its total Bitcoin stash to 12,345 BTC purchased for about $1.20 billion. Supply Numbers Tighten Only one-third of Bitcoin’s fixed supply remains “liquid,” meaning it’s likely to trade hands. That squeeze could make it harder for new buyers to find inventory. Over-the-counter desks and exchange order books report thinner BTC listings. When institutions can’t source coins as easily, they may bid prices higher. On-chain metrics can’t tell us why coins are unmoved—some may be lost forever—but the uptick in self-custody transfers shows real demand. Related Reading: TRUMP Token In Trouble? Over $4 Million Liquidity Exit Sparks Crash Fears Forecasts Suggest Price Pressure Ahead At Bitcoin Conference 2025, Eric Trump predicted that he believes BTC will hit $170K at the end of 2026. He pointed out that the number of firms with Bitcoin has doubled in the last year. But if a supply crunch is matched with steady or increasing demand, prices might experience a strong push higher. Yet markets may remain unpredictable. Unexpected sell-offs or macro shocks can turn the trend around quicker than anyone can imagine. Investors and analysts will be monitoring the pace of new entrants into the market. For the time being, a record 14.35 million Bitcoin are sleeping idle, and that constricted supply may lay the groundwork for the next great rally. title: Bakkt Eyes Crypto Purchases with Potential  $1 Billion Raise
body: Bakkt made this move despite financial uncertainty and a sharp year-to-date decline in its stock price. In the UK, The Smarter Web Company raised £41.2 million just days after buying nearly 200 BTC, growing its holdings to over 543 Bitcoin. Meanwhile, Genius Group plans to use some of the proceeds from two billion-dollar lawsuits to buy up to 5,000 BTC and pay shareholder dividends. Overall, it is clear that several companies are making strategic moves into Bitcoin as part of their corporate treasury strategies. Bakkt Could Enter Bitcoin Market Bakkt Holdings Inc., the crypto-focused subsidiary of Intercontinental Exchange, made a bold financial move by filing a Form S-3 with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing outlines the company’s intent to raise up to $1 billion through a variety of securities offerings, including Class A common stock, preferred stock, debt securities, warrants, or combinations thereof. This capital may be used to purchase Bitcoin and other digital assets, which means that the company is seriously considering a shift in its treasury strategy. Earlier this month, Bakkt updated its investment policy to allow for allocations into digital assets. While the company has not yet made any cryptocurrency purchases, the filing indicates that it may do so using excess cash or proceeds from the forthcoming securities offerings. This approach aligns with the broader trend among tech and finance companies incorporating Bitcoin into their balance sheets. Bakkt said that any future acquisitions of crypto assets will be determined based on market conditions, business performance, capital market receptivity, and other strategic factors. However, this ambitious plan comes at a precarious time for Bakkt. The company admitted in the same filing that it faces financial uncertainty, and stated that it has a limited operating history and ongoing operational losses. Moreover, the firm disclosed that it “identified conditions and events that raised substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern.” This means that raising new capital will be crucial to stabilize its financial footing. Bakkt YTD share price (Source: Google Finance ) Despite these challenges, Bakkt saw a modest 3% uptick in its share price on Thursday, closing at $13.33. Still, the stock is down 46% since the beginning of the year, partly due to the loss of major clients like Bank of America and Webull, which chose not to renew their commercial agreements. Nonetheless, Bakkt is still optimistic about the future of digital assets. The company recently shared its excitement about a wave of upcoming crypto IPOs, including filings from Circle, eToro, and Gemini. In a post on X , Bakkt described these developments as positive indicators that suggest growing institutional momentum and maturity in the crypto market. UK Firm Ramps Up Bitcoin and Raises Millions The Smarter Web Company, a UK-based web design and marketing firm, also recently raised £41.2 million from institutional investors just days after making a large Bitcoin purchase. The capital was secured through an accelerated bookbuild process and a subscription offering, allowing the company to raise £36.27 million from the bookbuild and an additional £4.97 million from subscription participants. The shares were offered at a price of £2.90 ($3.98) each, with the new stock expected to take effect from July 1. This fundraising effort closely followed the company’s announcement that it bought 196.8 Bitcoin at an average price of $103,290 per BTC. It ended up spending over $20 million on the purchase. As of Tuesday, The Smarter Web Company held a total of 543.52 Bitcoin, which was acquired at an average price of $104,450. This means that its crypto treasury has a valuation of around $58.19 million based on current prices. The company has been actively growing its Bitcoin holdings, and increased its stack by 460.28 BTC in June alone. At the end of May, the firm held only 83.24 BTC. The company began its Bitcoin treasury strategy in April, although it has accepted Bitcoin as a form of payment since 2023. Despite these aggressive moves into the digital asset space, its stock performance has shown volatility. The Smarter Web Company trades on the OTCQB market in the United States under the ticker TSWCF. On Thursday, its shares declined by 15%, closing at $3.56 after reaching an intraday low of $3.19. In after-hours trading, the stock slipped an additional 1.8% to $3.49. Nevertheless, the company’s shares are still up 270+% year-to-date. Smarter Web Company YTD share price (Source: Google Finance ) Other UK firms are also jumping into Bitcoin despite the country’s regulatory ambiguity around digital assets. On Tuesday, London-listed Bitcoin treasury firm Vinanz announced the acquisition of 37.72 BTC. Meanwhile, investment firm Abraxas Capital made headlines in April with a $250 million Bitcoin purchase. Genius Group Plans Bitcoin Boost from Lawsuit Wins Other firms are finding creative ways to stock up on crypto. Genius Group, an artificial intelligence-driven education technology firm, announced plans to distribute any proceeds from ongoing billion-dollar lawsuits directly to shareholders while allocating a large portion to expanding its Bitcoin treasury. In a press release that was issued on Thursday, the company’s board of directors approved a strategy to repurpose potential winnings from two legal cases seeking over $1 billion in combined damages. One of the lawsuits has already been filed under the Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act (RICO), targeting LZGI International with claims exceeding $750 million. The second lawsuit, according to CEO Roger Hamilton , is expected to be filed soon. Based on 2023 figures, Genius Group estimates damages of at least $262 million, although the amount could grow as it accounts for potential harm from 2024 and 2025. Hamilton explained that the legal actions are designed to recover shareholder value lost due to alleged misconduct by the defendants. He also affirmed the board's position that any recovered funds should be used solely to benefit shareholders. Under the proposed distribution model, 50% of any legal winnings will be paid out as a special dividend, while the remaining 50% would be allocated to purchasing Bitcoin for the company’s treasury. If Genius Group successfully wins both cases, the payout will amount to approximately $7 per share, and the firm would acquire around 5,000 Bitcoin based on current market prices. The company clarified, however, that there is no guarantee of winning either case or receiving any proceeds. Genius Group has already made moves to build its Bitcoin holdings. In fact, it increased its treasury by over 50% in June through a series of acquisitions. The company is targeting a total of 1,000 BTC for its corporate treasury.

title: Tokenization Firm Midas Introduces Private Credit Product with Fasanara, Morpho and Steakhouse
body: Midas , a protocol for issuing yield-bearing tokens backed by U.S. Treasuries and other assets, has introduced a blockchain-based private credit product, with the help of institutional asset manager Fasanara and crypto natives Morpho and Steakhouse, the companies said on Friday. Midas’ mF-ONE, a blockchain-native investment certificate, is structured to track Fasanara’s F-ONE fund composed of allocations across fintech-originated receivables, SME lending, real estate-backed credit, and delta-neutral digital strategies. Qualified investors can collateralize mF-ONE in a mF-ONE/USDC Morpho Market and borrow USDC liquidity supplied from USDC vaults curated by Steakhouse, according to a press release. This allows customers to borrow stablecoins against their holdings and gain capital efficiency while maintaining exposure to a credit strategy. Back in February, Midas introduced Liquid Yield Tokens (LYT) linked to actively managed, decentralized finance (DeFi) funds, starting out with Edge Capital, RE7 Capital, and MEV Capital. The mF-ONE launch is supported by participation from leading DeFi and institutions, including: Stake Capital, GSR, Hardcore Labs, SumCap and CIAN.

title: DWF Ventures Report Reveals $76 Billion Crypto Treasury Investment by Public Companies
body: June 27, 2025 – Dubai, United Arab Emirates Leading Web 3.0 venture capital firm DWF Ventures has published a research report revealing the growth in crypto treasury investment by public companies. It has identified 14 companies that have rolled out a crypto investment strategy, and who collectively now hold digital assets worth $76 billion. In the past year, DWF Ventures has noted investments of more than $40 billion made by public companies. It pinpoints a total of 14 such companies that now have significant crypto treasuries. Aside from the Michael Saylor-led Strategy with its $67 billion investment, DWF Ventures cites public companies such as Trump Media, GameStop, Metaplanet, Tesla and Semler Scientific. The report examines the different ways in which publicly listed companies can raise capital and deploy crypto treasuries. Examples include private investment in PIPE (Public Equity), ATM (At-the-Market) Equity Sales, Credit Facility, Reverse Merger and Company Treasury. It notes the popularity of PIPE and convertible notes as used by the likes of Trump Media, Interactive Strength and GameStop. DWF Ventures also explores the crypto assets that public companies have elected to acquire. Bitcoin predictably dominates – but it highlights examples of companies that have established altcoin treasuries. These include Nano Labs (BNB) as well as companies investing in ETH, SOL, SUI and TRX. One of the more interesting deals that was examined as a case study is Tron’s reverse merger. This will effectively see Tron go public in the US through a reverse merger with Nasdaq-listed SRM Entertainment Inc. (SRM). SRM Entertainment has also entered into a $100 million equity agreement to fund its Tron treasury. The report concludes, “Building on our recent investment in Interactive Strength (TRNR) for the FET treasury, DWF Labs is actively exploring further opportunities within the US equity market. “The company is keen to engage in similar structured deals moving forward.” The DWF Ventures crypto treasury report can be read in full here . This perspective reflects the ongoing evolution of traditional banking systems to accommodate digital assets and blockchain technology. Ripple’s Approach to Solving Financial Problems Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse also featured in the video, providing a clear summary of Ripple’s role in the financial landscape. title: Bit Digital Unlocks $150M for Pivotal Ethereum Staking Future
body: BitcoinWorld Bit Digital Unlocks $150M for Pivotal Ethereum Staking Future The cryptocurrency world is constantly evolving, with companies making strategic moves to adapt and thrive. One such significant development comes from Bit Digital , a Nasdaq-listed digital asset platform, which has just announced a groundbreaking shift in its operational focus. Securing a substantial $150 million through a public offering, the company is set to deepen its commitment to Ethereum staking and robust treasury management. This isn’t just a financial raise; it’s a clear signal of a strategic pivot away from its traditional Bitcoin mining roots, signaling a new chapter for the firm and potentially setting a precedent for others in the digital asset space. Bit Digital’s Bold New Direction: Why the Pivot? For years, Bit Digital was primarily known for its extensive Bitcoin mining operations. However, the landscape of digital assets is dynamic, with changing market conditions, technological advancements, and evolving environmental considerations influencing business strategies. The decision to reduce involvement in Bitcoin mining and transition towards Ethereum staking and reserve management is a calculated move. This strategic realignment suggests a belief in the long-term viability and growth potential of Ethereum’s ecosystem, particularly with the transition to Proof-of-Stake (PoS) and its associated benefits like energy efficiency and potential for passive income through staking. It’s a testament to the company’s agility in navigating the volatile crypto market, seeking out more sustainable and potentially more profitable avenues for growth. Unpacking the $150 Million Public Offering: What Does it Mean? The acquisition of $150 million through a public offering is a significant financial milestone for Bit Digital . A public offering allows a company to raise capital by selling shares to the general public, often through an investment bank. For Bit Digital, this influx of capital provides substantial resources to fuel its new strategic direction. This isn’t merely about operational funding; it’s about investing in the infrastructure required for large-scale Ethereum staking, enhancing their treasury holdings, and potentially exploring new opportunities within the decentralized finance (DeFi) space. Such a large-scale fundraising effort through traditional financial markets also signals a growing institutional confidence in the digital asset sector, particularly in companies demonstrating adaptability and forward-thinking strategies. The Power of Ethereum Staking: A New Era for Digital Assets? At the core of Bit Digital ‘s new strategy lies Ethereum staking . With Ethereum’s successful transition to Proof-of-Stake, staking has emerged as a fundamental mechanism for securing the network while offering participants a way to earn rewards. For Bit Digital, this means committing a portion of their ETH holdings to validate transactions on the Ethereum blockchain, thereby earning a yield on their assets. This model offers several compelling benefits: Passive Income Generation: Staking provides a consistent revenue stream, offering a potentially more predictable income compared to the fluctuating revenues of Bitcoin mining. Environmental Friendliness: PoS is significantly more energy-efficient than Proof-of-Work (PoW), aligning with increasing global demands for sustainable business practices. Network Participation: By staking, Bit Digital becomes an active participant in securing and decentralizing the Ethereum network, contributing to the health and robustness of the ecosystem. This pivot could position Bit Digital as a major player in the evolving landscape of digital asset management , focusing on yield generation and ecosystem participation rather than energy-intensive computation. Strategic Crypto Investment: Bit Digital’s Treasury Focus Beyond Ethereum staking , Bit Digital ‘s enhanced focus on treasury management is equally critical. In the volatile world of cryptocurrencies, effective treasury management involves strategically holding and managing digital assets to optimize returns, mitigate risks, and ensure liquidity. With the $150 million raised, Bit Digital can diversify its digital asset holdings, potentially investing in a broader portfolio of cryptocurrencies or stablecoins, in addition to its ETH staking initiatives. This approach reflects a sophisticated understanding of crypto investment strategies, moving towards a more diversified and robust financial foundation. It’s about building a resilient balance sheet that can withstand market fluctuations while capitalizing on growth opportunities within the broader digital asset economy. What’s Next for Bit Digital and the Digital Asset Landscape? Bit Digital ‘s strategic pivot could serve as a blueprint for other companies in the digital asset platform space. As the industry matures, we are likely to see more firms exploring diverse revenue streams beyond traditional mining, embracing models that align with sustainability and long-term value creation. For investors, Bit Digital’s move offers a clearer, potentially more stable investment proposition focused on yield-bearing assets and prudent treasury management. However, challenges remain, including regulatory uncertainties, smart contract risks associated with staking, and the inherent volatility of the crypto market. Despite these, Bit Digital’s bold step underscores a growing trend of maturation and diversification within the digital asset ecosystem, pointing towards a future where flexibility and strategic adaptation are key to success. In conclusion, Bit Digital ‘s successful $150 million public offering and its subsequent pivot towards Ethereum staking and strategic treasury management mark a significant moment for the company and the broader digital asset industry. This move not only strengthens Bit Digital’s financial position but also showcases a forward-thinking approach to navigating the evolving crypto landscape. By embracing new technologies and diversified revenue streams, Bit Digital is poised to carve out a strong presence in the future of digital asset management, demonstrating that adaptability and innovation are paramount in this rapidly advancing sector. title: Crypto espionage? How the Nobitex hack may tie into Israeli spy arrests: report
body: The fallout from the Nobitex hack is still unfolding, and it may no longer be just about the missing funds as new reports point to a possible link between the breach and the recent arrests of three Israeli citizens. According to the blockchain intelligence platform TRM Labs, Israeli authorities have arrested three individuals accused of spying for Iran. The suspects, aged between 19 and 28, were allegedly recruited by Iranian handlers to carry out intelligence-related tasks in exchange for cryptocurrency. Their activities ranged from surveillance and photographing military sites to tagging pro-Iran graffiti and tracking high-profile officials. Details of the arrests surfaced on June 24, coming just days after the June 18 Nobitex hack . The breach, which resulted in losses exceeding $90 million, was carried by Gonjeshke Darande, the pro-Israel hacking collective known for targeting Iranian-linked infrastructure. You might also like: Over $90M stolen from Iran’s Nobitex exchange burnt by pro-Israel hacker group Per TRM Labs, the cyberattack may have done more than just drain wallets. While no direct link between the two events has been confirmed, the analysis suggests that data obtained during the Nobitex breach may have played a role in identifying the recently arrested suspects. From hacks to handcuffs? Both Israeli cyber defense teams and Gonjeshke Darande, also known as Predatory Sparrow, have a history of using cyber tools for intelligence gathering. In this case, they may have accessed internal data such as wallet information, KYC records, or private communications, which potentially aided the identification of the Iranian handlers or tracing payments to operatives. That possibility is supported by the leak of Nobitex’s sensitive data just a day after the breach, suggesting the hackers had deep access into the exchange’s infrastructure. You might also like: Iran imposes curfew on crypto exchanges following Nobitex hack The arrested suspects were reportedly paid thousands of dollars for various operations, with funds delivered through anonymized channels. Israeli authorities said these payments were traceable on-chain and formed part of the evidence used in the investigation. Meanwhile, the Nobitex hack also revealed suspicious fund movements by the exchange dating back several months, tied to illicit activity and potential money laundering. A separate investigation pointed to quiet, structured fund transfers, and the use of stealth tactics to obscure their trail. In some cases, those funds were linked to wallets associated with malicious actors, and the emergence of the potential ties to espionage raises further questions about Nobitex’s transparency and operations. If Pi shows real progress, trust may return. If not, the doubts will only grow.

title: Resolv Token’s Resilient Stand: Defying Volatility with Strategic Buybacks
body: BitcoinWorld Resolv Token’s Resilient Stand: Defying Volatility with Strategic Buybacks The cryptocurrency market is a dynamic landscape, often characterized by swift shifts and unpredictable volatility. In such an environment, investor confidence hinges on transparency and robust project fundamentals. Recently, the DeFi protocol Resolv (RESOLV) has stepped into the spotlight with a crucial announcement that aims to reinforce trust and demonstrate its unwavering commitment to its ecosystem. What’s Behind Resolv Token’s Strategic Maneuvers Amidst Market Swings? In a period where many projects might be tempted to offload assets to weather the storm, Resolv has taken a remarkably different approach. Tim Shekikhachev, Customer Success Manager at Resolv, recently addressed the community on X (formerly Twitter), unequivocally stating that the company has not sold any RESOLV tokens despite the recent market turbulence. This declaration is a powerful signal of the team’s long-term vision and belief in their own project. Shekikhachev elaborated on the circulating supply, noting that over 15% of RESOLV’s total supply has already entered the market. This includes tokens distributed through various channels such as airdrops, allocations for market makers to ensure healthy trading environments, and incentive programs designed to reward early adopters and active participants. Despite this significant portion of the Resolv token supply being in public hands, the foundation has consistently remained a net buyer. This means that, on balance, Resolv has been acquiring more tokens from the open market than it has been distributing or selling, showcasing a strong commitment to supporting its token’s value. This proactive stance is particularly noteworthy in a market segment often scrutinized for transparency and sustainability. Resolv’s decision to maintain a net buyer position underscores its dedication to the health and stability of its token ecosystem, providing a clear contrast to projects that might liquidate holdings during downturns. Understanding RESOLV Price Stability in Volatile Times One of the primary concerns for any token holder during periods of intense market fluctuations is the potential impact on the RESOLV price . Resolv’s strategy of being a net buyer, especially during volatility, directly addresses this concern. By actively purchasing tokens from the market, the protocol can help absorb selling pressure, reduce circulating supply, and potentially mitigate sharp downward price movements. This mechanism is akin to a stock buyback, where a company repurchases its own shares to reduce the number of outstanding shares, often leading to an increase in earnings per share and, consequently, share price. The announcement that the RESOLV team purchased an impressive 1.6 million RESOLV tokens within a 24-hour period further solidifies this commitment. This substantial buyback demonstrates not just a theoretical commitment but a practical, actionable strategy to support the token’s value. Such actions can instill confidence among existing holders and attract new investors who see a project willing to invest in its own future, even when the broader market is uncertain. Here’s a quick look at how such a strategy can benefit the token’s stability: Reduced Selling Pressure: Buybacks absorb tokens that might otherwise be sold on the open market, lessening downward price momentum. Increased Scarcity: By taking tokens out of circulation (or at least out of active selling pressure), the relative scarcity of the token can increase. Enhanced Investor Confidence: A project actively investing in its own token signals strong belief and long-term commitment. Improved Fundamentals: Demonstrates financial health and a strategic approach to treasury management. How DeFi Protocol Resolv Navigates Token Liquidity and Market Dynamics? For any DeFi protocol , maintaining robust token liquidity is paramount. Liquidity ensures that users can easily buy and sell tokens without significant price slippage, which is crucial for a healthy and active ecosystem. Resolv’s approach to liquidity involves several facets: Market Maker Inventory: A portion of the 15% circulating supply mentioned by Shekikhachev is allocated to market makers. These entities play a vital role in providing depth to trading pairs, ensuring there’s always a buyer and a seller available. By facilitating smooth transactions, market makers enhance the overall user experience and attract more participants to the Resolv ecosystem. Incentive Allocations: Tokens are also distributed as incentives, encouraging users to engage with the protocol, provide liquidity, or participate in governance. While these tokens enter the market, they also drive utility and adoption, which are long-term drivers of value. Foundation as Net Buyer: The foundation’s commitment to being a net buyer acts as a counter-balance to the natural flow of tokens into the market from airdrops and incentives. This strategic purchasing ensures that the demand side remains strong, preventing an oversupply that could negatively impact liquidity and price. This balanced approach allows Resolv to distribute tokens for growth and ecosystem development while simultaneously ensuring that the core value proposition of the token remains strong through strategic acquisitions. It’s a testament to a well-thought-out tokenomics model designed for long-term sustainability rather than short-term gains. Navigating Crypto Market Volatility: Resolv’s Proactive Stance The broader crypto market volatility has been a defining characteristic of recent times, driven by macroeconomic factors, regulatory uncertainties, and shifts in investor sentiment. In this challenging environment, projects that demonstrate resilience and a clear strategy stand out. Resolv’s public announcement and substantial buyback activity position it as a protocol that is not merely reacting to market conditions but actively shaping its own narrative. This proactive stance is a critical differentiator. Instead of allowing external market forces to dictate its token’s trajectory, Resolv is asserting control through strategic financial operations. This commitment helps to build a stronger community, fostering loyalty among existing users and attracting new ones who seek stability and reliability in their DeFi investments. Key Takeaways from Resolv’s Strategy: Transparency: Open communication about token sales and buybacks builds trust. Commitment: Being a net buyer signals a deep belief in the project’s future. Stability: Active market intervention can help stabilize token price during downturns. Long-Term Vision: Prioritizing ecosystem health over short-term liquidations. For investors, this provides a valuable insight into the project’s health and management philosophy. It suggests that Resolv is not just building a product but also nurturing its economic backbone, which is crucial for sustained growth in the competitive DeFi landscape. Conclusion: A Resilient Future for Resolv? Resolv’s recent actions underscore a robust and investor-friendly approach to navigating the often-turbulent waters of the cryptocurrency market. By denying token sales and actively engaging in significant buybacks, the DeFi protocol has sent a clear message: it is committed to the long-term stability and success of the RESOLV token. This strategic decision, particularly amidst widespread market volatility, sets a precedent for transparency and dedication that can significantly bolster investor confidence and differentiate Resolv in the crowded DeFi space. As the market continues to evolve, Resolv’s proactive and resilient stance positions it for a potentially stable and promising future, proving that strategic financial management is just as vital as technological innovation in the world of decentralized finance. title: Asia FX Trends: Crucial Insights as Dollar Struggles at 3-Year Low
body: BitcoinWorld Asia FX Trends: Crucial Insights as Dollar Struggles at 3-Year Low In the intricate dance of global finance, even seemingly distant movements can ripple through every corner of the market, including the volatile world of cryptocurrencies. Recently, the Asia FX trends have remained remarkably muted, while the mighty US Dollar finds itself grappling at a three-year low. This intriguing divergence, coupled with the impending release of critical PCE inflation data, sets the stage for a period of heightened anticipation and potential shifts across the global forex market . For those invested in digital assets, understanding these macroeconomic currents is not just academic; it’s a strategic imperative. Let’s delve into what’s truly happening and what it could mean for your portfolio. Understanding Asia FX Trends: What’s Driving the Muted Movement? The Asian foreign exchange markets have been notably quiet, a stark contrast to the volatility often seen in other regions. This muted activity in Asia FX trends is not a sign of stagnation but rather a reflection of several underlying factors creating a delicate balance. Imagine a tug-of-war where neither side can gain significant ground; that’s essentially what we’re observing. China’s Economic Recovery: As the economic powerhouse of Asia, China’s post-pandemic recovery has been a key determinant. While growth has resumed, it hasn’t been explosive enough to trigger massive capital inflows or outflows that would typically cause significant currency swings. The stability of the Yuan (CNY) often anchors other regional currencies. Central Bank Policies: Central banks across Asia, such as the Bank of Japan (BoJ) and the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), have largely maintained accommodative or steady monetary policies. Unlike some Western counterparts, they haven’t embarked on aggressive interest rate hikes that would dramatically alter interest rate differentials and, consequently, currency exchange rates . Regional Trade Dynamics: Intra-Asian trade remains robust, providing a foundational stability. While global trade faces headwinds, the interconnectedness of Asian economies helps to absorb some external shocks, leading to less dramatic movements in their respective currencies. Capital Flows: Investor sentiment towards Asia has been mixed. While some see growth opportunities, others remain cautious about geopolitical tensions or specific country risks. This balanced sentiment results in net capital flows that are not strong enough in one direction to cause significant currency appreciation or depreciation. This stability in Asia FX trends can be a double-edged sword. On one hand, it reduces immediate risks for businesses operating in the region. On the other, it might indicate a lack of strong catalysts for growth or a wait-and-see approach from major investors, potentially affecting the broader global forex market . The US Dollar Performance: Why is the Greenback Struggling? While Asian currencies have been relatively stable, the US Dollar performance tells a different story. The greenback has been grappling, hitting a three-year low against a basket of major currencies. This weakness is a significant development, as the US Dollar traditionally serves as the world’s primary reserve currency and a safe haven during times of uncertainty. So, what’s causing this slump? Federal Reserve’s Dovish Stance: The Federal Reserve has signaled a more cautious approach to monetary policy, with expectations of interest rate cuts gaining traction. When a central bank indicates lower interest rates, it generally makes the country’s currency less attractive to foreign investors seeking higher yields, putting downward pressure on the dollar. Inflation Expectations: While inflation has been a concern, the market’s expectation that it is under control, coupled with the Fed’s stance, reduces the need for a strong dollar to combat rising prices. This directly influences the US Dollar performance . US Debt Ceiling Concerns: Although often resolved, recurring debates around the US debt ceiling can introduce an element of uncertainty. This political risk, even if temporary, can erode investor confidence in US assets, including the dollar. Global Risk Appetite: A general increase in global risk appetite can lead investors to move funds out of safe-haven assets like the dollar and into riskier, higher-yielding assets, including emerging market currencies or even cryptocurrencies. This shift impacts currency exchange rates globally. The struggling US Dollar performance has wide-ranging implications. A weaker dollar makes US exports cheaper, potentially boosting American businesses. However, it also makes imports more expensive and can reduce the purchasing power of dollar-denominated assets for international investors. For crypto enthusiasts, a weaker dollar can sometimes be seen as a bullish signal for Bitcoin and other digital assets, as investors seek alternatives to traditional fiat currencies. PCE Inflation Data: The Economic Indicator Everyone’s Watching In the midst of these currency dynamics, all eyes are turning towards the upcoming release of the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index data. Why is this particular economic indicator so critical? Because the PCE is the Federal Reserve’s preferred measure of inflation. While the Consumer Price Index (CPI) gets a lot of headlines, the Fed views PCE as a more comprehensive and accurate gauge of underlying inflation trends. What is PCE and Why is it Important? The PCE measures the prices of goods and services purchased by consumers. It differs from CPI in a few key ways: Scope: PCE has a broader scope, including not just out-of-pocket expenses but also payments made on behalf of consumers by employers or government programs (e.g., medical care). Weighting: PCE allows for changes in consumer spending habits. If the price of one item rises significantly, consumers might substitute it with a cheaper alternative. PCE reflects this substitution, whereas CPI uses a fixed basket of goods. This makes PCE a more dynamic measure of inflation. Historical Revision: PCE data can be revised as more information becomes available, providing a more accurate long-term picture. The upcoming PCE inflation data will provide crucial insights into whether inflationary pressures are truly moderating as the Fed hopes. A lower-than-expected PCE reading would reinforce the dovish stance of the Fed, potentially further weakening the dollar and supporting the narrative for interest rate cuts. Conversely, a higher-than-expected reading could cause the dollar to strengthen as markets price in a more hawkish Fed, leading to renewed volatility in the global forex market and impacting currency exchange rates . For investors, paying close attention to the PCE inflation data is paramount. It’s a key piece of the puzzle that informs the Fed’s next moves, which in turn dictate the broader economic environment affecting everything from bond yields to equity markets and, yes, even the price of Bitcoin. Navigating the Global Forex Market: Opportunities and Challenges The global forex market is the largest and most liquid financial market in the world, with trillions of dollars exchanged daily. Its sheer size and constant activity present both significant opportunities and formidable challenges for participants. Understanding its intricate workings is vital for anyone looking to make informed financial decisions, especially when considering how it intertwines with other asset classes like cryptocurrencies. Opportunities in Forex: High Liquidity: The forex market’s immense liquidity means trades can be executed quickly and efficiently, reducing the risk of slippage. 24/5 Trading: Unlike stock markets, forex operates around the clock from Monday to Friday, offering flexibility for traders worldwide. Hedging: Businesses and investors can use forex to hedge against currency risk, protecting the value of their international assets and revenues from adverse movements in currency exchange rates . Diversification: Forex can serve as a diversification tool within a broader investment portfolio, offering exposure to different economic cycles and policy decisions that might not directly correlate with equity or bond markets. Challenges in Forex: High Volatility: While offering opportunities, volatility can also lead to rapid and unpredictable losses if not managed carefully. Economic data releases, geopolitical events, and central bank announcements can cause sudden shifts. Leverage Risk: Forex trading often involves high leverage, which can amplify both gains and losses, requiring strict risk management. Complexity: The interplay of global economic factors, interest rate differentials, political stability, and market sentiment makes forex analysis complex and demanding. Information Overload: The sheer volume of news and data influencing currency exchange rates can be overwhelming, making it difficult to filter out noise from actionable signals. For crypto investors, understanding the global forex market is crucial because it provides context for macro trends. A strong dollar might pressure Bitcoin, while a weak dollar could provide tailwinds. Shifts in Asia FX trends or the impact of PCE inflation data can indirectly influence capital flows into or out of digital assets, making forex a foundational layer of macro analysis. Impact on Currency Exchange Rates: What Does This Mean for You? The movements of currency exchange rates are not just abstract numbers on a screen; they have tangible effects on everyday life and investment decisions. Whether you’re planning a vacation, importing goods, or simply watching your investment portfolio, changes in how currencies value against each other can significantly impact your financial standing. Direct Impacts: International Travel: A weaker local currency means your money buys less abroad, making international travel more expensive. Conversely, a stronger currency makes foreign destinations more affordable. Purchasing Power: If your local currency strengthens against others, imported goods become cheaper, increasing your purchasing power. If it weakens, imports become more expensive, potentially leading to inflation. Business Competitiveness: For businesses engaged in international trade, favorable currency exchange rates can boost profits by making exports more competitive or imports cheaper. Indirect Impacts for Investors: Dollar-Denominated Assets: Many global commodities (like oil and gold) and digital assets (like Bitcoin) are priced in US Dollars. When the US Dollar performance is weak, these assets can become more attractive to non-dollar holders, potentially driving up their prices. International Investments: If you hold investments in foreign stocks or bonds, changes in currency exchange rates can either amplify or diminish your returns when converting profits back to your home currency. Inflation and Interest Rates: As discussed with PCE inflation data , currency movements can influence inflation. A weakening currency can lead to imported inflation, which might prompt central banks to raise interest rates, affecting everything from mortgage rates to loan costs. For the crypto community, understanding currency exchange rates is vital. While Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies aim to be decentralized, their value is often benchmarked against fiat currencies, primarily the US Dollar. Therefore, a struggling US Dollar performance or shifts in Asia FX trends can create a narrative that either supports or challenges the digital asset market, making it essential to monitor these traditional financial indicators. Conclusion: Navigating the Interconnected Global Financial Landscape The current landscape of the global forex market is a complex tapestry woven with threads of economic data, central bank policies, and geopolitical sentiments. The muted activity in Asia FX trends , juxtaposed with the struggling US Dollar performance , highlights a period of significant transition and uncertainty. The impending release of PCE inflation data looms large, poised to be a key catalyst that could dictate the direction of these vital currency exchange rates in the near term. For investors, particularly those navigating the dynamic world of cryptocurrencies, staying informed about these macroeconomic shifts is not merely an academic exercise; it’s a strategic necessity. The traditional financial markets, with their intricate dependencies, exert a powerful influence on the broader investment climate, including the digital asset space. By understanding the forces at play – from inflation metrics to central bank postures and global trade dynamics – you can better anticipate market movements, identify potential opportunities, and mitigate risks, ultimately positioning yourself for more informed decision-making in an increasingly interconnected financial world. title: Crypto Hacks Hit Record $2.1 Billion in H1 2025 as Private Key Exploits Dominate
body: The first half of 2025 has seen crypto-related hacks soar to a record $2.1 billion, driven primarily by private key exploits and front-end compromises, according to a new report from blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs. The losses have already surpassed the previous high set in 2022 by around 10% and are on track to eclipse the total thefts recorded throughout 2024. TRM Labs’ analysis found that over 80% of crypto stolen across 75 incidents this year came from infrastructure attacks, which typically result in ten times higher losses than other attack types. These attacks often involve stealing wallet seed phrases or manipulating user-facing components of protocols to reroute funds. Protocol Hacks and State Actors Fuel the Surge Protocol exploits, such as flash loan and re-entrancy hacks , accounted for 12% of all losses during this period, targeting vulnerabilities in smart contracts and blockchain protocol logic. This method of exploitation allows attackers to siphon funds or disrupt services while leaving limited traces. The report highlighted the February hack of Dubai-based exchange Bybit , allegedly carried out by North Korean threat actors, as a key contributor to this year’s record losses. The attack alone drained $1.5 billion, accounting for nearly 70% of the total crypto stolen in 2025 so far. Other notable incidents include a $100 million hack of Iran’s Nobitex by the pro-Israel hacker group Predatory Sparrow in June. These incidents pushed the average hack size to nearly $30 million, double the average loss reported in the first half of 2024. TRM Labs noted that January, April, May, and June each saw monthly thefts exceeding $100 million, signaling a persistent and evolving threat to the digital asset ecosystem. Collective Action and Stronger Defenses TRM Labs urged the crypto industry to adopt robust security measures, including multifactor authentication, cold wallet storage, regular audits, and improved detection of insider threats. The report also emphasized the need for advanced social engineering defenses, given attackers’ increased reliance on manipulating users. TRM Labs concluded that addressing the rising wave of crypto hacks requires “multifaceted collaboration” between blockchain intelligence firms, law enforcement, and financial monitoring agencies worldwide. The firm warned that the record-breaking hacks in H1 2025 should serve as a wake-up call, underscoring the need for a globally aligned and proactive security posture against cybercriminals and state-sponsored threats alike. title: Ripple Taps Wormhole to Link XRP Ledger with 35+ Blockchains — XRP Rally Incoming?
body: Ripple has integrated Wormhole to connect the XRP Ledger and its EVM-compatible sidechain with more than 35 blockchains, a move that could significantly boost XRP’s interoperability and reach. Key Takeaways: Ripple’s Wormhole integration links XRP Ledger to over 35 blockchains, boosting cross-chain capabilities. Developers can now build dApps that operate across multiple networks, expanding XRP’s DeFi utility. Ripple aims to use the integration to enhance its offerings in tokenization and liquidity provision. Announced Thursday, the integration allows XRP-native decentralized applications to interact with networks like Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche, BNB Chain, and Polygon. Ripple plans to leverage the new connectivity to grow its offerings in decentralized finance, tokenization, and liquidity provision. Ripple and Wormhole Integration Unlocks Multi-Chain dApp Development Developers will now be able to create dApps that operate seamlessly across multiple ecosystems, enhancing XRP’s utility in decentralized finance and other sectors. “If you want real mass adoption, interoperability is essential,” said David Schwartz, CTO of Ripple and Co-creator of the XRP Ledger. “The infrastructure has to be there, not just on one chain, but across them. With this integration, tokens natively issued on the XRP Ledger are being set up for that reality by being able to move between blockchain networks while maintaining native issuance and control.” Wormhole’s cross-chain bridge aims to help XRP solidify its status as an institutional-grade blockchain. @Wormhole is announcing a partnership with @Ripple to bring multichain interoperability to the XRP Ledger and the upcoming XRPL EVM Sidechain. Wormhole will be the core interoperability solution for the XRPL ecosystem. This integration will bring institutional-grade… pic.twitter.com/xqTD5PU7Tp — Wormhole (@wormhole) June 26, 2025 “By integrating Wormhole into the XRP Ledger, we’re helping unlock even greater potential spanning all major blockchains for one of the most established blockchain networks in enterprise finance,” Robinson Burkey, Co-Founder of the Wormhole Foundation, said. As Ripple doubles down on interoperability, market watchers will be looking for signs that these efforts could translate into renewed momentum for XRP. XRP Ledger Upgrade Adds Institutional Tokens As reported, RippleX, the development arm of Ripple, has rolled out version 2.5.0 of the XRP Ledger , introducing several protocol upgrades aimed at strengthening network functionality and security. RippleX engineer Mayukha Vadari has called the upgrade “possibly the best single lineup of amendments” ever released, introducing significant improvements to token management and transaction processing. The XLS-85 amendment upgrades the escrow system by allowing third-party issued tokens, including stablecoins, and introduces multi-purpose tokens designed for institutional applications. Another key change, XLS-56, enables wrapper transactions that can combine up to eight steps into a single action, aiming to lower failure rates in complex transaction flows and improve network efficiency for advanced use cases. The new update comes as the XRP Ledger has recorded a surge in user activity , with the number of daily active addresses climbing from an average of 35,000 to over 295,000. Alongside growing usage, the number of whale wallets holding over 1 million XRP has reached an all-time high of 2,700 — a milestone not seen in the 12-year history of the protocol. The rise in large holders may reflect growing institutional or high-net-worth conviction in XRP’s long-term value. In May, VivoPower also invested $121 million in XRP as a strategic reserve, making it the first company in the world with an XRP-focused treasury. title: Across Protocol: Alarming Allegations of $23M ACX Token Misappropriation Emerge
body: BitcoinWorld Across Protocol: Alarming Allegations of $23M ACX Token Misappropriation Emerge The world of decentralized finance (DeFi) thrives on trust, transparency, and community governance. Yet, recent allegations have sent shockwaves through this very foundation, raising serious questions about the integrity of a prominent cross-chain intents protocol. Across Protocol , a name synonymous with bridging digital assets, now finds itself at the center of a storm involving alleged financial misconduct and manipulated governance votes. If true, these claims could profoundly impact investor confidence and the future of DeFi governance. What Are the Core Allegations Against Across Protocol? At the heart of the controversy are startling claims made by Ogle, an advisor at World Liberty Financial (WLFI). In a recent X post, Ogle accused the Across Protocol team of orchestrating a scheme to siphon off a staggering $23 million in ACX tokens . The alleged method? Manipulating the outcome of a crucial governance vote. Specifically, the accusation states that 150 million ACX tokens , valued at approximately $23 million at the time, were transferred to Risk Labs. Risk Labs is reportedly the for-profit entity behind Across Protocol . These transfers were allegedly disguised under the seemingly innocuous labels of “strategic investment” and “retroactive funding.” However, critics argue these labels served as a cover for a direct transfer of community-held assets into the hands of the protocol’s core team. Unpacking the Alleged ACX Tokens Vote Manipulation The gravity of the situation deepens when examining the mechanics of the alleged manipulation. Ogle’s post meticulously details how the Across Protocol team purportedly leveraged ‘insider addresses’ to sway the results of the governance vote manipulation . In a truly decentralized system, governance proposals are meant to be decided by the collective will of token holders, ensuring fair and transparent decision-making. However, according to the allegations, these insider addresses were strategically deployed to push the proposal past the required quorum. Ogle emphasized that without the engagement of these ‘insider’ votes, the proposal would have failed due to insufficient participation. This suggests a deliberate effort to bypass genuine community consensus, undermining the very principles of decentralized governance. The direct consequence of these actions, as highlighted by Ogle, is the creation of potential token selling pressure, which directly harms legitimate ACX token holders. Why Do Governance Vote Manipulation Claims Matter in DeFi? The allegations against Across Protocol are not just about a large sum of money; they strike at the core of what decentralized finance security aims to achieve. DeFi protocols are designed to operate without central intermediaries, relying instead on smart contracts and community-driven governance. This model promises transparency, censorship resistance, and true user ownership. However, incidents like the alleged governance vote manipulation by the Across Protocol team expose critical vulnerabilities. When the very mechanisms designed to ensure fairness can be exploited by those in power, it erodes trust. This raises fundamental questions: Can users truly trust a system where insider interests can override community consensus? How robust are existing governance frameworks against such alleged exploits? What recourse do token holders have when their collective power is allegedly undermined? These questions are vital for the long-term health and adoption of DeFi. The integrity of governance votes is paramount, as it dictates the future direction, treasury allocation, and overall security of a protocol. The Wider Impact of Crypto Allegations on Trust Beyond the immediate financial implications for ACX token holders, these crypto allegations cast a long shadow over the broader decentralized finance ecosystem. Trust is the bedrock of any financial system, and in the nascent world of DeFi, it is even more critical. Each alleged scandal, each instance of insider dealing, chips away at the collective confidence of investors, developers, and new entrants. Such incidents can lead to: Reduced Investor Confidence: Potential investors may become wary of participating in DeFi projects, fearing similar exploits. Regulatory Scrutiny: Allegations of manipulation and misappropriation often invite increased attention from regulators, potentially leading to stricter rules that could stifle innovation. Reputational Damage: Not just for the accused protocol, but for the entire sector, making it harder to attract mainstream adoption. However, incidents that betray these principles are a stark reminder of the ongoing need for vigilance and robust ethical frameworks within the community. Navigating Decentralized Finance Security Challenges The alleged events surrounding Across Protocol underscore the persistent decentralized finance security challenges that the industry must continuously address. While DeFi offers immense opportunities, it also presents unique risks that differ from traditional finance. The immutability of blockchain transactions means that once an exploit or a malicious act occurs, it is incredibly difficult, if not impossible, to reverse. To bolster decentralized finance security and prevent future incidents of alleged governance vote manipulation , several measures are crucial: Enhanced Audits: Beyond code audits, governance mechanisms themselves need rigorous scrutiny to identify potential vulnerabilities for manipulation. Transparent On-Chain Data: Tools and platforms that make it easier for the community to monitor voting patterns, large token movements, and treasury transactions can serve as early warning systems. Stronger Community Engagement: Actively encouraging a broader base of token holders to participate in governance can dilute the power of concentrated insider interests. Clear Disclosure Policies: Protocols should have explicit rules regarding team holdings, vesting schedules, and any potential conflicts of interest related to governance. Legal Recourse: While challenging in a decentralized environment, exploring frameworks for accountability and recourse for affected token holders is essential for maturing the space. The allegations against Across Protocol serve as a potent reminder that decentralization is not a magic bullet against all forms of misconduct. It requires continuous effort, community oversight, and a commitment to ethical practices from all participants. What’s Next for Across Protocol and ACX Holders? As these serious allegations circulate, the eyes of the crypto community will remain fixed on Across Protocol . For ACX token holders, understanding the full implications of these alleged actions on their investments and the protocol’s long-term viability is paramount. Conclusion The alleged misappropriation of $23 million in ACX tokens by the Across Protocol team, facilitated by alleged governance vote manipulation , is a deeply concerning development for the DeFi ecosystem. title: Kenya Proposes Joint Crypto Regulatory Body as Nation Eyes Leadership in African Crypto Space
body: The post Kenya Proposes Joint Crypto Regulatory Body as Nation Eyes Leadership in African Crypto Space appeared first on Coinpedia Fintech News With the cryptocurrency market booming in 2025, Kenya has taken a major step toward regulating digital assets. The country’s National Assembly Finance and Planning Committee has proposed the formation of a multi-agency regulatory framework to oversee crypto operations, marking a pivotal moment for the region’s virtual asset industry. Kenya’s New Crypto Regulatory Framework Driven by the explosive growth of the crypto sector, Kenyan lawmakers are moving quickly to establish oversight mechanisms. The proposed framework brings together five key government agencies to regulate Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs): Central Bank of Kenya Capital Markets Authority Competition Authority of Kenya Communications Authority of Kenya Office of the Data Protection Commissioner These bodies will collectively regulate various aspects of the crypto ecosystem, including market conduct, data protection, and digital infrastructure. Why Kenya Introduced This Crypto Proposal The proposal stems from a recommendation by Credence Sfrica, a social enterprise organization, which called for a cross-sectoral regulatory team to supervise the rapidly expanding crypto market. The initiative is now open for public feedback, as the Finance Committee aims to build a collaborative and transparent crypto policy. Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs) Bill Gains Momentum Introduced on April 4, 2025, the Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASP) Bill has received strong support from key players in the crypto industry. The Virtual Asset Chamber (VAC) praised the bill but recommended removing a controversial clause that allowed regulators to conduct off-site surveillance of VASPs without clear boundaries. The committee agreed with the VAC and has amended the bill accordingly. [post_titles_links postid=”475547″] Kenya Aims to Become Africa’s Crypto Hub Kenya is positioning itself as a crypto leader in Africa, moving past its earlier caution. The new VASP Bill is designed to strengthen financial transparency, accountability, and combat illicit financial flows. Lawmakers believe it will help protect consumers and legitimize the crypto space in the country. Key Requirement for VASPs If the bill is passed, all entities engaging in crypto operations in Kenya will be required to obtain a local license approved by the five regulatory agencies. These licensed VASPs must also implement internal policies to identify and manage conflicts of interest and report such matters to authorities. “This Bill puts a strong emphasis on conflict prevention and proper management among virtual asset providers,” said MP Kimani Kuria . “It requires entities to establish effective internal controls to ensure transparency and accountability.” Final Thoughts As Kenya prepares to pass its first comprehensive crypto regulation , it sends a clear signal of intent: the nation is serious about embracing digital finance while safeguarding its citizens. If implemented successfully, this could place Kenya at the forefront of Africa’s blockchain revolution. In Kenya, a 1.5% tax is imposed on every crypto transaction, which applies to transfers and exchanges regardless of whether a gain is made. This is a revised rate from an earlier 3%. Why is Kenya introducing this new crypto regulatory framework? Kenya aims to regulate its booming crypto sector to enhance financial transparency, accountability, combat illicit financial flows, protect consumers, and legitimize the crypto space, positioning itself as an African crypto hub. What is the Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASP) Bill in Kenya? Introduced on April 4, 2025, the VASP Bill is Kenya’s comprehensive legislation to license and regulate crypto operations. It emphasizes conflict prevention and requires VASPs to implement internal controls for transparency.

title: XRP ETF on the Horizon? BlackRock’s Possible Move Explained
body: In June 2025, the crypto world was afire with rumors that BlackRock—the largest asset manager in the world, with $11 trillion in assets under management—was going to submit an application for a spot XRP ETF. Although the rumors are yet to be confirmed by any official SEC filing or BlackRock press release, the mere possibility has reverberated across traditional finance and the digital asset universe. So what exactly is an XRP ETF, how would it work, and why is the potential entrance of BlackRock such a big deal? What Is an XRP ETF? An XRP ETF (Exchange-Traded Fund) is an investment product designed to track the price action of XRP, the Ripple Labs cryptocurrency. Instead of buying XRP directly from a cryptocurrency exchange, investors can buy shares of the ETF in regular brokerage accounts. A share represents a proportionate interest in the underlying XRP position of the fund. The following is a general description of how an XRP ETF operates: Fund Creation : The issuer (e.g., BlackRock) buys XRP or related instruments to back the ETF. Asset Backing : The value of each ETF share is directly proportional to the amount of XRP the fund is holding. Exchange Trading : Shares are listed on stock exchanges and traded the same as common stocks. Net Asset Value (NAV) : The NAV is the total value of the XRP in the fund divided by outstanding shares, though market prices may vary slightly depending on trading volume. Management Fees : Issuers charge a small percentage as a management fee for operating the fund. This arrangement allows investors to gain exposure to XRP's price movement without the hassle of private keys, wallets, or having to interact with crypto exchanges. Why Does BlackRock's Interest Matter So Much? BlackRock's push into Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs was a landmark moment for institutional crypto adoption. The firm's reputation and regulatory strictness gave Wall Street's stamp of approval to digital assets, paving the way for pension funds, hedge funds, and retail investors who were wary of taking direct crypto exposure. A BlackRock XRP ETF application would signal growing confidence in the regulatory status of XRP along with its utilization as a mainstream asset. It would greatly help improve liquidity, market stability, and potentially drive XRP's price much higher than its all-time highs, according to industry watchers. The Current State Despite the hype, there is no official word from the official sources that BlackRock has filed—or will imminently file—for an XRP ETF. Previous speculation in April and May 2025 was not based on facts, and BlackRock representatives have repeatedly indicated they are not currently interested in altcoins like XRP, in large part due to ongoing legal uncertainty regarding Ripple and the SEC. Other managers, including Franklin Templeton, Grayscale, and 21Shares, have already applied for spot XRP ETFs and are awaiting SEC rulings. The SEC recently delayed a decision on several of these products, pointing to the regulatory uncertainty that still exists. What Would Happen If BlackRock Filed for an XRP ETF? If BlackRock were to actually file for an XRP ETF, the impact would be seismic: Wider Access : Traditional investors could invest in XRP through traditional brokerage accounts, without the complexity of crypto wallets and private keys. Liquidity Boost : The influx of institutional money would initiate greater trading volumes and market depth, reducing volatility. Price Effect : Analysts have predicted that XRP could double in price, potentially surpassing its all-time high of $3.40 and even reaching as high as $4.60 within months, after the same explosive rallies that happened when Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs were added. Legitimacy Boost : BlackRock's involvement would be a powerful vote of confidence in XRP, potentially impacting public and institutional attitudes and further mainstream adoption. How an XRP ETF Bridges Traditional and Crypto Finance ETFs are a familiar wrapper for traditional investors, offering regulatory oversight, ease of access, and transparency. By putting XRP into this wrapper, an ETF would be capable of bridging the gap between traditional finance and the evolving landscape of digital assets. This would open the door to a whole new wave of investors that have been deterred by the technical and security concerns of direct crypto ownership. The Road Ahead While the expectation is genuine, caution is warranted. The history of false starts among the XRP community can only serve to highlight the need for skepticism until there is an actual filing. Regulatory clarity remains a significant hurdle, and BlackRock's risk aversion will have it potentially waiting for the green light from the SEC before making a move. Still, the sheer speculation testifies to the growing appetite for crypto entry into mainstream finance. With regulatory clarity and institutional interest on the rise, the prospect of an XRP ETF—one backed by a giant like BlackRock—could be closer than most expect. In brief : The idea of a BlackRock XRP ETF is so far speculation, but if it does materialize at some time in the future, it would be a game-changer for XRP and the crypto space in general, opening the doors to institutional money and mainstream adoption. Until that time, investors would do well to watch SEC filings—and the news wires—very closely.

title: US Crypto Policy: GENIUS Act Poised to Unleash New Era for Stablecoin Regulation
body: BitcoinWorld US Crypto Policy: GENIUS Act Poised to Unleash New Era for Stablecoin Regulation The cryptocurrency world is buzzing with anticipation as July approaches, poised to become a landmark month for US crypto policy . From legislative breakthroughs to the potential reshaping of the digital asset landscape, key decisions are on the horizon that could redefine how cryptocurrencies operate within the United States. Are you ready for the seismic shifts about to hit the crypto ecosystem? What is the GENIUS Act and How Will it Impact Stablecoin Regulation? At the heart of the upcoming legislative changes is the GENIUS Act , a piece of legislation specifically designed to introduce stringent rules for stablecoin issuers. Stablecoins, digital currencies pegged to stable assets like the U.S. dollar, have become a cornerstone of the crypto economy, facilitating trades, remittances, and lending. However, their rapid growth has also raised concerns among regulators regarding consumer protection, financial stability, and illicit finance. The GENIUS Act is expected to bring much-needed clarity and oversight to this rapidly evolving sector. While the full details of the bill are yet to be widely publicized, reports suggest it will focus on: Reserve Requirements: Mandating that stablecoin issuers hold verifiable, high-quality reserves to back their tokens, ensuring a 1:1 peg and preventing situations like the TerraUSD collapse. Auditing and Transparency: Requiring regular, independent audits of stablecoin reserves and public disclosure of these reports, enhancing trust and accountability. Licensing and Supervision: Establishing a clear regulatory framework for stablecoin issuers, potentially requiring them to obtain specific licenses and adhere to ongoing supervisory oversight by federal or state authorities. Consumer Protections: Implementing measures to safeguard user funds, including clear disclosures about risks, redemption rights, and mechanisms for dispute resolution. The implications of robust stablecoin regulation are far-reaching. For consumers, it could mean greater security and confidence in using stablecoins. For the industry, while compliance costs may increase, it could also pave the way for broader institutional adoption and integration of stablecoins into traditional financial systems, legitimized by a clear regulatory stamp. Who is David Sacks and What is His Role in Shaping US Crypto Policy? The recent insights into July’s legislative agenda come from David Sacks, notably referred to by Cointelegraph on X as the White House’s AI and crypto czar. While not a traditional government title, Sacks is a prominent figure in the tech and venture capital world, known for his involvement with PayPal and various successful tech companies. His statements carry significant weight, indicating a growing focus within high-level U.S. government circles on the burgeoning digital asset space. Sacks’s commentary underscores the administration’s recognition of cryptocurrencies and artificial intelligence as critical areas for national policy. His role, whether formal or advisory, highlights a concerted effort to bring clarity and structure to a sector that has largely operated in a regulatory grey area. The fact that someone with his reported influence is signaling a definitive timeline for significant legislation like the GENIUS Act emphasizes the urgency and priority placed on developing comprehensive US crypto policy . This engagement from figures like David Sacks suggests a shift from merely observing to actively shaping the future of digital assets, aiming to foster innovation while mitigating risks. It signals a more proactive stance from the U.S. government, moving towards a framework that seeks to integrate digital assets responsibly into the broader financial system. What Does the CLARITY Bill Mean for the Crypto Market Structure? Beyond stablecoins, July is also slated to be crucial for broader crypto market structure. The CLARITY crypto market structure bill is reportedly heading to the Senate, promising to provide much-needed guidance for the entire digital asset ecosystem. Currently, the classification of digital assets (e.g., as securities or commodities) remains a significant point of contention, leading to regulatory uncertainty and hindering innovation. The CLARITY bill aims to address this ambiguity by potentially: Defining Digital Asset Classifications: Establishing clear legal definitions for various types of digital assets, helping exchanges, developers, and investors understand which regulations apply to them. Jurisdictional Clarity: Specifying which regulatory bodies (e.g., SEC, CFTC) have oversight over different aspects of the crypto market, reducing inter-agency disputes and providing a single point of contact for compliance. Market Integrity Rules: Introducing rules around trading practices, preventing market manipulation, and ensuring fair and orderly markets, similar to those in traditional finance. Investor Protection Frameworks: Creating robust frameworks to protect retail and institutional investors from fraud, scams, and market volatility, potentially through disclosure requirements and investor education initiatives. A clear and consistent crypto market structure is vital for the industry’s maturation. It would allow businesses to innovate with greater confidence, attract more institutional capital, and provide a safer environment for individual participants. This bill, alongside the GENIUS Act, represents a holistic approach to regulating the digital economy, moving beyond piecemeal enforcement actions to a comprehensive legislative framework. The Road Ahead: Navigating New Stablecoin Regulation and Crypto Market Structure With the GENIUS Act expected to be signed into law and the CLARITY bill progressing through the Senate, the coming months will demand significant adaptation from all participants in the crypto space. The new era of stablecoin regulation will require issuers to re-evaluate their operational models, reserve management, and compliance protocols. This could lead to a consolidation in the stablecoin market, with only the most robust and compliant entities surviving and thriving. For the broader crypto market structure , exchanges, DeFi protocols, and decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) will need to carefully analyze the new classifications and jurisdictional mandates. This might necessitate changes in how tokens are listed, how trading platforms operate, and how investor funds are handled. While challenging, this regulatory clarity could ultimately unlock significant growth by fostering trust and attracting mainstream financial institutions that have been hesitant due to regulatory uncertainty. Actionable Insights for the Crypto Community: Stay Informed: Closely monitor official announcements and detailed breakdowns of the GENIUS Act and CLARITY bill as they become public. Assess Impact: Businesses should conduct internal assessments to understand how the new regulations will affect their operations, products, and services. Engage with Policy Makers: Industry associations and individual companies should consider engaging with lawmakers and regulators to provide feedback and advocate for practical implementation. Prioritize Compliance: Start preparing for potential compliance requirements now, even before the full details are solidified. This includes reviewing internal controls, data management, and legal frameworks. The legislative push reflects a global trend towards greater oversight of digital assets. The U.S., as a major financial hub, plays a crucial role in setting precedents. The decisions made in July will not only impact the domestic market but could also influence regulatory approaches worldwide, shaping the global future of finance. A Transformative July for US Crypto Policy July is undeniably set to be a transformative month for the U.S. crypto landscape. With the anticipated signing of the GENIUS Act and the progression of the CLARITY bill, the U.S. is moving decisively towards a more regulated and defined digital asset ecosystem. This legislative push, championed by influential figures like David Sacks, signals a clear intent to foster responsible innovation, enhance investor protection, and integrate cryptocurrencies more formally into the financial system. While the path to compliance may present challenges, the long-term benefits of clarity and stability could unleash unprecedented growth and mainstream adoption for digital assets. The crypto community must remain vigilant, adaptable, and proactive to navigate this pivotal moment and seize the opportunities it presents. title: South Korean payments firm Kakaopay tumbles 17% as regulators sound alarm on stablecoins
body: Shares of Kakaopay dropped sharply after volatile trading as regulators warn of risks tied to widespread stablecoin adoption. Shares of South Korean digital payments firm Kakaopay tumbled as much as 17% on June 27 after trading resumed Thursday, following a one-day suspension by the Korea Exchange, Bloomberg reported . The halt came just days after an earlier suspension on Tuesday, triggered by a sharp rally that saw the stock surge around 50% in two sessions. Moreover, the stock has tripled in value over the past month, fueled by investor excitement over the company’s potential move into stablecoins. Source: Bloomberg The exchange suspended the stock twice due to its extreme price volatility, ultimately designating Kakaopay as an “investment risk.” “Kakaopay was definitely overheated and went ahead of its fundamentals,” said Shawn Oh, an equities trader at NH Investment & Securities Co. in Seoul. “Going forward, the stock will face a reality check.” You might also like: South Korea’s top banks unite for Won-pegged stablecoin launch: report As previously reported by the Korea Times, Kakao Pay recently filed 18 trademark applications. KakaoBank, another major Kakao Group affiliate, has also submitted multiple trademark applications related to its stablecoin business, covering cryptocurrency software, financial transaction services, and mining under brand names such as BKRW and KRWB. “We submitted the trademark applications to proactively respond to developments in the stablecoin market,” a KakaoBank official said. “We will continue to carefully monitor relevant legal frameworks and market dynamics.” These moves coincide with accelerated legislative discussions in South Korea’s National Assembly on the Digital Asset Framework Act, which, once enacted, would permit issuance of won-pegged stablecoins and open the market to major financial and fintech firms like KakaoBank and Kakao Pay. However, the Bank of Korea recently cautioned that the widespread adoption of stablecoins could lead to risks including market instability caused by mass withdrawals (coin runs) and disturbances in the foreign exchange market. Similarly, the Bank for International Settlements noted that stablecoins are not a substitute for traditional money, and their future role remains “unclear.” You might also like: South Korean Democrats want to accelerate KRW stablecoin rollout
